• The Stern–Gerlach experiment demonstrates that the electron has a property called spin, which leads to a magnetic dipole moment. Spin is quantized with only two allowed values described by the quantum number ms. Complete de- termination of the quantum state of the electron requires values for all four quantum numbers (n, ,, m, ms).

This method generates a set of one-electron wave functions called the Hartree orbitals a(r) with energy values a, where a represents the proper set of quantum numbers.
